import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_92/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_92/training_1.csv"

Source2_92_0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
Source2_92_1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN Source2_92_0 and Source2_92_1 on "city"
joined_df = pd.merge(Source2_92_0, Source2_92_1, on="city", how="inner")

# Operation 2: group_by Source2_92_1.type, aggregations = count(Source2_92_0.ride_id)
# Group by 'type' column from Source2_92_1 and count the number of ride_id from Source2_92_0
result = joined_df.groupby('type', as_index=False).agg(ride_id=('ride_id', 'count'))

# Ensure the target schema: ['type': string, 'ride_id': integer]
result['type'] = result['type'].astype(str)
result['ride_id'] = result['ride_id'].astype(int)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_92/target_multisource.csv"
result.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
